windows.text: Hale came to Valtern in the spring of his twentieth year. He carried one bag and a letter of introduction.
The old banker died late in the summer. Hale walked behind the coffin through the empty streets of Valtern.
In the district everyone knew Valtern, and nobody had a bad word for Valtern.
Hale came to Valtern in the spring of his twentieth year. He carried one bag and a letter of introduction.
Hale found a room above a chandler's shop. He paid a month in advance and slept until noon.
Hale stayed behind with the ledgers. He learned the bankers' hand and then the bankers' silences.
In the district everyone knew Hale, and nobody had a bad word for Hale.
